package_info.package_versions: Windows and Mac versions distributed prior to March 29, 2023 (exact versions not specified)
package_info.why_malicious: The 3CXDesktopApp package was compromised during the build process, resulting in the distribution of maliciously modified libraries (ffmpeg.dll and d3dcompiler_47.dll) that enabled the download and execution of infostealer malware. This allowed attackers to exfiltrate sensitive system and browsing data from customer environments.

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: RC4 encrypted shellcode appended to the signature appendix of d3dcompiler_47.dll, executed via a call from ffmpeg.dll.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code decrypts and executes shellcode embedded in d3dcompiler_47.dll, which initiates network communication with attacker-controlled command-and-control infrastructure.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Appending and executing encrypted shellcode from a signed DLL is a classic malware technique to evade detection and leverage trusted binaries.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate DLLs should not contain or execute encrypted shellcode, nor initiate unauthorized network connections.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some security or DRM software may use obfuscated code, but not in this context or manner.
key_indicators: RC4 encrypted shellcode in DLL signature appendix

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Reference to d3dcompiler_47.dll added to ffmpeg.dll, which is used to call and execute the shellcode in d3dcompiler_47.dll.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the modified ffmpeg.dll loads d3dcompiler_47.dll and triggers execution of the embedded shellcode, facilitating the initial stage of the attack chain.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Modifying a standard library to load and execute another DLL's shellcode is a known malware loader technique.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: ffmpeg.dll should only provide multimedia functionality, not load or execute unrelated DLLs or shellcode.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: DLL chaining for plugin systems, but not for executing encrypted payloads.

execution_context.file_location: memory (downloaded payload, e.g., ICONIC infostealer, guard64.dll, Gopuram backdoor)

malicious_snippets.code_snippet: Malicious payload (ICONIC infostealer, guard64.dll, Gopuram backdoor) downloaded and executed in memory, collects system information and browsing history, uploads to C2 server.
malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the downloaded payload collects system and browser data, then exfiltrates it to attacker-controlled infrastructure.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Unsolicited collection and exfiltration of sensitive data is a hallmark of infostealer and backdoor malware.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Legitimate software should not collect or transmit user/system data without consent.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Enterprise monitoring tools (with user consent), but not in this context.
key_indicators: Network connections to known C2 infrastructure

attack_chain.action: User installs or updates 3CXDesktopApp, which loads malicious ffmpeg.dll and d3dcompiler_47.dll.
Shellcode is decrypted and executed, establishing contact with attacker C2 infrastructure.
Malicious payload (infostealer/backdoor) is downloaded and executed in memory.
System and browser data is collected and exfiltrated to attacker-controlled servers.
attack_chain.leads_to: Attacker gains access to sensitive information

behavioral_signatures: Execution of RC4-decrypted shellcode from DLLs loaded by trusted applications
Unexpected network connections from ffmpeg.dll or d3dcompiler_47.dll
Loading of guard64.dll or Gopuram backdoor in 3CXDesktopApp process
Collection and exfiltration of browser/system data by non-browser processes
file_indicators: Modified ffmpeg.dll and d3dcompiler_47.dll with appended/encrypted shellcode
Presence of guard64.dll in process memory
Unexpected references between ffmpeg.dll and d3dcompiler_47.dll
network_indicators: Connections to attacker-controlled C2 domains/IPs (as identified by threat intel feeds)
Unusual outbound traffic from 3CXDesktopApp.exe or its loaded DLLs
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for unexpected DLL loading and execution patterns in 3CXDesktopApp processes, especially involving ffmpeg.dll and d3dcompiler_47.dll. Flag any RC4 or other encrypted data appended to DLLs. Detect network connections from these processes to known malicious infrastructure. Alert on the presence or loading of guard64.dll or Gopuram backdoor components. Use EDR/XDR solutions to correlate suspicious file, process, and network activity.
